strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
At last, we've caught up... the Gran Garan and the Goraon...
The Wil Wiph...! Drake Luft!
Amuro... that's...
Yes... I've seen it before.
When we were thrown into Byston Well... that's the battleship we fought!
First time we've fought their battleship... Yurika, are you all right?
No problem! We've got Aura Battleships on our side too!
Heh, I'm sick of guys who are nothing but big...
I'll punch right through that huge body with my Gekigan Punch...!
...It won't go like last time, I'm afraid.
What, what do you mean?
It's rising... their Aura Power...!
You mean they've powered up!?
Doesn't look like we can let our guard down...
Drake Luft...! Do you desire not only Byston Well,
but this surface world as well?
With no way back to Byston Well, of course I turn to the surface!
Besides... I wish to see. Just how far I can go.
Do you think such selfishness... will be permitted!?
I am in a position where it is permitted.
Oh my, seems he won't listen to a word, huh.
Tch.
Father!
Hm... Rimuru!?
Father! Please, stop this!
The surface... something terrible is about to happen on the surface!
It's not for us people of Byston Well to meddle in! Drake!
...But it was surely someone on the surface who led us to this land.
Someone on the surface...?
I know not their intent. ...But I'd be a fool not to seize this chance.
...That someone... when we fought in Byston Well before...
...you mean the mysterious enemy that attacked us.
...The Einst series...!
They made contact several times. It was a young girl, but...
...I'm going out!
H-Hey! Kyosuke! All of a sudden... oh!
Koji! A young girl... could it be...!
All units, launch! Hurry!
Drake...!
Father!
...Rimuru, perhaps I am a clown.
But a clown ought to act the clown... and chase a dream.
You could still withdraw your army, even now!
That I cannot do...
Why!?
...The power of the Aura Machines... has bound the worlds too closely.
That's true...
...Here on the surface... we are beings that must be purged.
Father...
You understand that much, and yet...!
Then why not pull back your troops! We're not monsters!
Just lie low until the fighting on the surface is settled!
...All units, launch!
Tch, he's lost it...!
Drake!
Drake Luft!
I believe I too have eyes to see the world.
...But a personal grudge... that, I will settle...!
You'd kill your own daughter too!?
That's... not what a father does!
This is a battlefield. Spare us your petty sentimentality.
Shot Weapon...!
Lord Drake resolved to rule the surface after a momentous decision.
That's a lie! Father...!
Wow... this has gotten pretty intense...
Looks like it runs deep...
I don't care what's going on!
I won't forgive a guy who'd use his own daughter as a stepping stone!
Shot Weapon... what are you scheming!
Nothing. I merely serve Lord Drake.
...You're not the kind of man who'd be satisfied with just that...!
Musie, those who won't listen must be made to. I'm counting on you.
Yes, Lord Shot.
(Drake, you fool... blabbing about things you needn't...)
Forgive me, Rimuru... Commence the attack!
We have no choice... Let's go...!
Ooooh! I... came all this way... only to die here!?
This surge of aura...! Burn! You're...!
Ooooooooooh!
Show... Show Zama! If only... if only you didn't exist!
That's got nothing to do with it!
You can't control your hateful aura... You'd be the same without me!
If not for you... I'd have no one to hate! You...
So the Wil Wiph sinks...
Heh heh... so be it... This too must have been fate.
Drake Luft...!
I still believe there was no mistake in what I sought...
My one regret... is never learning who it was that used us.
Those who used... King Drake...?
...The Einst.
Father!
...Rimuru, I was a foolish father... but I must tell you this.
What opened the Aura Road and brought surface folk to Byston Well...
Black Knight...! Burn Bunnings! You've shown up again!
Reinforcements!? They sure keep at it!
Hey, that robot... no, a fighter with arms! That's...!
No doubt about it! This aura is...!
You're late, Black Knight!
Yes, sir. Readjusting this Garaba took longer than expected. But...!
I'll hear your excuses later! Do it, Black Knight!
Show, this time my Aura Power will
Burn Bunnings!
Hold on, Show! Hatred... power against power will destroy you both!
Going Hyper would...!
Holy Warrior... I may not have the strength to suppress a Hyper again...
Show, Show!
I know! But this fight...!
Don't rush it, Show!
That's right, Show! If you give in to anger...!
Burn! What have you gained with that rancor!
Power... and cunning! With them, I will win...!
I won't kill a man!! I'll kill that rancor!!
Eek! Show! It's happening again! Burn... Burn's machine is...!
I haven't lost yet...! No, I will win! Show Zama!
Burn Bunnings!
I'll show you that power gained from hatred and rancor achieves nothing!
Holy Warrior!
Lady Elle, that power... I'll sever it here!
Burn Bunnings...
It's not... your fault, Show. He... brought it on himself...
I know, Cham.
But just from hating... only that, so much power... That's what scares me.
The power... of hatred...
Human karma, eh?
Big Bro, that Black Knight's obsession... it's just like...
...Like Ilbora, you mean? Tch, gimme a break...
Hm? What's wrong, Kyosuke? Hey.
The power of hatred... a power only humans can achieve... I see.
...This aura is!?
...What is this? No, this aura is...!
Ah... ahh... Show...!
Cham!?
...They're coming!
Multiple unidentified craft nearby. No boson reaction.
Enemies that appear out of nowhere with no boson reaction... that means...
That mysterious enemy!?
Oh dear... we've only just left the dock,
and it seems I'll have to budget for another resupply...
...Excellen...!
There she is! ...But, but... there's a machine I've never seen...?
What!? What is this pressure!?
The enemy has a new model now too... no, wait... that's...
...It's the Weissritter. No doubt about it.
The Weissritter? Did it look like that?
No way! The shape's way too different!
(The original form... and an evolved form... The mysterious enemy is...!)
But why show up in a situation like this!
Probably... because it's a situation like this...! Excellen!
Kyosuke, you seem to have grasped something?
(Most likely...)
...Power... most... terrifying... the root...
The root...? The root of what!
What're you doing! Save the thinking for later!
Oh, you'll think later, will you? ...Guess this is no time for jokes.
If it's like before... the enemy's only after us! Stay sharp!
Honestly, one thing after another... Well, at least we won't get bored.
...Kyosuke...
Excellen...!
The Tobikage...!?
The Tobikage!
That small machine... it appeared in Byston Well too...!
Here it comes, here it comes! Appearing gallantly without a word...
It's cool in a different way from Rom and the others!
A little helper arrives. Lend us your strength, Ninja Warrior!
Tobikage! Over here, over here!
...That... too... Power... of... Beginning...
Ugh... ah... I... what am I...?
Excellen!? Could she... be back to normal!?
Kyosuke! Take her back!
Excellen!
...Kyosuke... I missed you...
Excellen... At last, the real you...
Thank goodness.
No time for sappy stuff!
Hey, no need to put it like that, right?
Yeah, Tetsuya.
...I'm saying it's dangerous.
The pilot may be sane, but the machine is still the enemy's!
Oh, r-right... Get her out, quick!
Ah! Ugh...!
What's wrong!?
...I guess... it's no good... I'm sorry... Kyosuke...
What!?
...I have to... tell you this much... This planet... Earth is...! The beginning...!
No...! Excellen!
How come? Didn't she come back to her senses?
It glowed...
Yeah. When that Weissritter knockoff flew off...
that jewel-like thing on its chest was glowing.
That's it. ...Looks like Tetsuya's hunch was right on the mark.
After all we've been through... Dammit!
Don't lose heart, Nanbu. ...Excellen seems to have come to her senses.
Now we just need to deal with that machine. Our chance will come...
Yes... Next time... Next time for sure...!
Father!
...So he didn't make it.
Drake... What... What were you trying to say!?
"The power that led us to Byston Well"... is what I heard. Did you?
Rimuru... cheer up.
Cham... Let's just... leave her be for now...
Everyone... please return to mopping up the enemy. Rimuru... well done...
Yes...
Drake's ambitions have come to nothing.
Once again... you have my deepest thanks, people of the surface...
Please allow me to thank you as well.
Please raise your head, Queen Sheela.
We merely fought to protect our own world.
If anything, we're grateful for your cooperation.
Quit being so stiff, Hazuki. Who cares? We won, didn't we?
At times like this, you'd better keep your mouth shut, Shinobu.
Shinobu can't read the room, you know.
That's quite a problem, isn't it?
You're the last one who should say that!
Eh, what's the harm?
Commander Hazuki had the same sort of exchange with Princess Romina.
Show?
...The evil aura... is fading.
Yes. It's as if it had been trapped inside the Wil Wiph.
But... I sense another... something far more alien... an aura...
So the fight... isn't over yet, huh?
Yeah... We still don't know what the Einst are after, either.
Those things... keep throwing new ones at us...
Data analysis complete.
The machine Excellen was piloting very likely used the Weissritter
as its base frame.
So much of this is hard to explain... How troublesome.
Anyway... shouldn't we be moving on to our next step?
Right. Commander Hazuki, have you chosen who's going up to space?
Yes, that's settled. We need to announce our next moves...
Queen Sheela, if you'd permit me?
Yes. All units, return to the Gran Garan.
...Father...
Kyosuke.
Sir.
I need to talk with you later. All right?
Understood.
